messages.subject: from fully reflective to second order formative
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to revise my fully reflective model to "1st order reflective, 2nd order formative model"

My fully reflective model is:

model = "
functional =~ a1 + a2 + a3
hedonic =~ b1 + b2 + b3
social =~ c1 + c2 + c3
risk =~ functional + functional + functional"

How can I revise my syntax?

I really appreciate your advice.

messages.author: b048c97bee0de8a7
messages.subject: Re: from fully reflective to second order formative
parts:
Correction:

risk =~ functional + hedonic + social


I am still waiting for your advice; I really appreciate it in advance.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: from fully reflective to second order formative
parts: I am trying to revise my fully reflective model to "1st order reflective, 2nd order formative model"

If you mean to say that "risk" should be defined with formative indicators, then use the operator  <~  instead of  =~

But I don't think your model will be identified unless risk also predicts other variables, such as another outcome or reflective indicators of risk.  See attached articles about formative measurement.

Terry
